selectedChoice.Rule-based processing: RPA bots execute predefined, structured steps following explicit business rules without deviation or judgment

selectedChoice.Direct materials variance 15.2% unfavora: Possible material waste or higher input prices requiring purchasing and production review
selectedChoice.Direct labor variance 2.4% unfavorable: Small labor inefficiency within normal tolerance; monitor but no immediate action
selectedChoice.Variable overhead 4.0% favorable: Lower variable overhead spending or usage than expected at actual production levels
selectedChoice.Sales volume 4.0% unfavorable: Fixed overhead spending exceeded the budget; review fixed cost commitments

selectedChoice.Flexible budget revenue: Actual units sold x Budgeted selling price per unit
selectedChoice.Flexible budget direct materials cost: Actual units produced x Standard material cost per unit
selectedChoice.Flexible budget variable overhead cost: Actual units produced x Standard variable overhead rate per unit
selectedChoice.Sales volume variance in dollars: (Actual units sold - Budgeted units sold) x Budgeted contribution margin per unit

selectedChoice.Renegotiate supplier contracts: Unfavorable direct materials price variance above threshold
selectedChoice.Launch promotional campaign: Unfavorable sales volume variance due to lost market share

selectedChoice.Labor rate variance: Human resources or union contract terms
